name: Evolved Structures: Generative Design and Digital Manufacturing at NASA (Ryan McClelland)
description: NASA Goddard research engineer Ryan McClelland's headline talk on 'evolved structures' — one-off spacecraft and instrument parts designed with commercial generative-design AI and digitally manufactured. Reports 3x performance gains and ~2/3 mass reduction over traditional components, with structures produced in hours instead of weeks.

name: From Text to Spaceship: Advancing AI in Aerospace (Ryan McClelland, NASA)
description: Follow-up CDFAM NYC 2024 keynote where McClelland traces NASA Goddard's roadmap from current generative-design workflows toward text-to-CAD and LLM-driven aerospace structure synthesis. Discusses lessons from production evolved-structure parts now flying on missions.

name: Superintelligence for Scientific Discovery in the Material World (Markus Buehler)
description: CDFAM NYC 2025 opening keynote by MIT's Markus Buehler on graph-aware multi-agent AI platforms that turn heterogeneous materials data into actionable science. Frames AI as a 'superintelligence' tool for materials discovery and bio-inspired engineering.

name: How NVIDIA is Accelerating Product Development (Ian Pegler)
description: CDFAM NYC 2025 closing keynote on accelerated computing and AI surrogate models for higher-fidelity simulation and real-time digital twins. Covers aerospace, automotive, energy, and marine workflows where GPU-native CFD plus surrogates collapse design-iteration cycles.

name: AI and the Battle for the Soul of Design (Chris McComb)
description: CMU's Chris McComb on the shifting role of human designers as generative AI takes over routine design generation. Discussion of human-AI collaboration patterns, design fixation, and trust calibration drawn from his lab's empirical studies.

name: Design You Can Trust: Explainability and Control in Physics-Driven Generative Design (Marco Pietropaoli, ToffeeX)
description: CDFAM NYC 2025 talk on making physics-driven generative design explainable and controllable for engineers. Addresses the black-box problem in topology optimization and AI-augmented design loops.

name: Real-Time Computer-Aided Optimization (CAO): GPU-Native CFD Changes the Industry (Flexcompute)
description: Flexcompute (Gregory Roberts/Qiqi Wang) on GPU-native CFD enabling real-time computer-aided optimization. Demonstrates how design iterations that took days now run interactively, blurring the line between simulation and design.

name: Building Beyond Imagination: AI-Native Engineering (Mark Huntington, PhysicsX)
description: PhysicsX co-founder on rebuilding the engineering stack around AI surrogates. Argues for AI-native engineering tools that compress simulation cycles and enable previously infeasible design exploration.

name: From 3 Configurations to 300: Rapid Trades for Advanced Aircraft Design (nTop)
description: nTop CEO Bradley Rothenberg on using implicit modeling to explode aircraft design trade studies from a handful of configurations to hundreds. Pitches implicit geometry as the missing primitive for AI-driven CAD.

name: Engineering Intelligence: Practical Applications of AI in Structural Engineering (Sergey Pigach, CORE Studio)
description: Thornton Tomasetti CORE Studio on AI-enabled workflows in structural engineering practice. Practitioner view of integrating ML surrogates and generative tools into production structural design.

name: Artificial Intuition: Building an AI Mind for Electromagnetic Design (Pratap Ranade, ARENA-AI)
description: ARENA-AI on building domain-specific AI for electromagnetic device design. Presents 'artificial intuition' — learned heuristics that match what experienced EM engineers do.

name: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Simulation Intelligence (Alexander Lavin, Pasteur Labs)
description: Pasteur Labs on 'simulation intelligence' — combining differentiable physics, surrogates, and probabilistic programming for digital engineering. Same talk delivered at CDFAM Amsterdam and NYC 2025.

name: Empowering Organizations with Engineering Intelligence (Luca Zampieri, Neural Concept)
description: Neural Concept Shape product talk on geometric deep-learning surrogates for CAE. Case studies in automotive and aerospace where GNN surrogates replace large parts of CFD/FEA loops.

name: Design as Dialogue: Form Jamming with AI Agents (HDR)
description: HDR architects (Goldsberry, Zhuang) on conversational form-finding with AI agents. Treats early-stage design as a dialogue between architect and a generative AI that proposes massings and form variations.

name: Accelerating Metal-to-Plastic Conversion with AI, Implicit CAD, and Mesh-Free Simulation (Eaton + Intact Solutions)
description: Joint Eaton + Intact Solutions case study on metal-to-plastic part conversion using implicit CAD geometry and mesh-free simulation. Pipeline shows how AI-assisted geometry editing collapses redesign time for cost-down programs.

name: Intelligent Anatomic Models from CT Utilizing ML (Matt Shomper, Not a Robot Engineering)
description: ML pipeline for converting CT scans into surgically usable anatomic CAD models. Builds on Shomper's earlier biomimetic-structure work shown at CDFAM 2023.

name: Concept to Manufacturing: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (Kristen Edwards, MIT DeCoDE Lab)
description: MIT DeCoDE Lab study on vision-language models as design judges and concept evaluators. Empirical results on how well VLMs assess design feasibility from concept sketches through manufactured parts.

name: AI Judges in Design: Statistical Perspectives on VLM Human Equivalence (Kristen Edwards, MIT)
description: Follow-up CDFAM Amsterdam 2025 talk extending the VLM-as-design-judge work with statistical tests for human-expert equivalence. Provides a blueprint for benchmarking AI design evaluators.

name: Industrializing Physics-Driven Generative Design (Thomas Rees, ToffeeX)
description: CDFAM Berlin 2024 talk by ToffeeX (London startup) on bringing physics-driven generative design — gradient-based topology optimization with embedded CFD/thermal — to industrial users.

name: Democratizing Advanced Engineering Solutions (Hyperganic, Moritz Huber)
description: CDFAM Berlin 2024 talk from Hyperganic on algorithmic / implicit-field engineering for rocket engines, heat exchangers, and similar high-performance parts. Pitches a code-first replacement for traditional parametric CAD.

name: Robust Designs - The Role of Variability (Andre Wilmes, Rafinex)
description: Rafinex talk on stochastic / robust topology optimization that explicitly handles load and manufacturing variability. Argues that single-load deterministic GD produces fragile parts; robust GD is the production-ready version.

name: AI Accelerated Engineering (Matthias Bauer, Navasto)
description: Navasto on data-driven CAE acceleration: training surrogate models on enterprise simulation archives so future runs become inference. CDFAM Berlin 2024.

name: Perfect Designs for Imperfect AM (Ole Sigmund, DTU)
description: Topology-optimization founding figure Ole Sigmund on designing for the realities of additive manufacturing — porosity, residual stress, support requirements — rather than ideal manufacturing. CDFAM Berlin 2024 keynote.

name: How AI Copilots Are Enabling AM Industry Scaling (Omar Fergani, 1000Kelvin)
description: 1000Kelvin on AMAIZE — an AI copilot that predicts and corrects defects in metal AM build parameters. CDFAM Berlin 2024 talk.

name: Industrial Challenges in Geometry Optimization for AM (Johannes Pauli, BMW)
description: BMW research engineer on integrating generative-design methods into BMW's body-in-white simulation process over three years. CDFAM Berlin 2024 afternoon keynote.

name: State of the Art B-Rep Generation (Karl Willis, Autodesk)
description: Karl Willis (Autodesk Research, lead author of Fusion 360 Gallery and SkexGen) on the current frontier of neural B-rep generation. CDFAM NYC 2024 talk.

name: Realizing Differentiable Physics in Digital Engineering (Alexander Lavin, Pasteur Labs)
description: Pasteur Labs CDFAM NYC 2024 talk on practical differentiable physics for digital engineering. Shows how end-to-end gradients through simulators unlock design optimization at scale.

name: Critical Overview of Machine Intelligence in Computational Design (Gabrielis Cerniauskas, Edinburgh)
description: Skeptical academic survey of where ML-in-design works and where it doesn't, with empirical examples. CDFAM NYC 2024 talk.

name: Computational Design for Large Gas Turbine Engines (nTop + Siemens Energy)
description: Joint nTop / Siemens Energy talk on using implicit modeling for gas-turbine component design — a regulated, high-stakes domain where complex internal cooling channels are now generative-design native. CDFAM NYC 2024.

name: Automating CAM with AI: Deep Learning for Geometry (Ben Schrauwen, Oqcam)
description: Oqcam (Belgian startup, co-founded by Ben Schrauwen of Showpad) on applying deep learning to CAM toolpath generation. CDFAM NYC 2024.

name: Knowledge, Data, Trust: Bridging High-Value Manufacturing and AI (Generative Engineering)
description: Generative Engineering (Joe Griston, Laurence Cook) on the data and trust gaps blocking AI deployment in regulated high-value manufacturing. CDFAM NYC 2024.

name: Generative Design & Digital Manufacturing at NASA Goddard (Ryan McClelland, 2023)
description: McClelland's first CDFAM talk introducing the evolved-structures program at NASA Goddard. The keynote that made generative design legible to the aerospace research community.

name: Roadmap to Replicators (Neil Gershenfeld, MIT CBA)
description: MIT CBA director Neil Gershenfeld's CDFAM 2023 closing keynote on the long-term arc from CAD to digital materials and self-replicating fabrication. Sets the philosophical frame for computational design.
organization: MIT Center for Bits and Atoms

name: Learning to Generate Shapes (Karl Willis, Autodesk AI Lab)
description: Willis's CDFAM 2023 overview of Autodesk AI Lab's work on neural shape generation, including the threads that became Project Bernini. Foundational talk linking academic neural-CAD work to commercial CAD.

name: Design for Artificial Intelligence: Force Multiplier for Additive (Chris McComb, CMU)
description: CMU's McComb argues that designers need to design parts that are easy for AI to optimize — inverting the usual framing. CDFAM 2023 talk.

name: Physics-Driven Generative Design at Hyperganic (Nina Korshunova)
description: Hyperganic's Korshunova on physics-driven generative design as the future of engineering CAD. CDFAM 2023.

name: Robust Geometry Processing for Physical Simulation and Shape Optimization (Daniele Panozzo, NYU)
description: NYU's Panozzo (libigl, gptoolbox author) on robust geometry-processing primitives that production simulation and shape optimization need. CDFAM 2023.

name: Computer Vision Training with Synthetic Data (Francis Bitonti, Lexset AI)
description: Lexset on synthetic data generation for training computer-vision models for industrial inspection. CDFAM 2023.

name: Computational Design, Evolutions (Mathew Vola, Arup)
description: Arup Fellow Mathew Vola's CDFAM Amsterdam 2025 keynote on the evolution of computational design in built-environment engineering practice. Practitioner perspective spanning two decades.

name: Constrained Creativity in AI-Accelerated Automotive Design (Ruben Verhack, Datameister)
description: Datameister on integrating AI into automotive styling and engineering loops while keeping designers in control. CDFAM Amsterdam 2025.

name: From Days to Hours: Accelerating RFQ Through Scalable FEA Automation (Synera)
description: Synera (formerly Elise) on automating FEA-driven RFQ response with scalable workflow graphs. CDFAM Amsterdam 2025.

name: Physics-Driven Generative Design for L-PBF in Aerospace (ToffeeX)
description: ToffeeX CDFAM Amsterdam 2025 talk specifically on Laser Powder-Bed Fusion aerospace parts — includes case studies with build-orientation and overhang constraints baked into the physics-driven optimizer.

name: Surrogate Models for Physics Simulation, No-Code (Asparuh Stoyanov, Key Ward)
description: Key Ward on a no-code platform for building ML surrogates of physics simulators. CDFAM Amsterdam 2025.

name: Building Beyond Imagination: Engineering with AI (Nico Haag, PhysicsX)
description: PhysicsX CDFAM Amsterdam 2025 talk on AI-native engineering tooling for energy and aerospace customers. Companion to Mark Huntington's NYC talk.

name: Geodesic Slicing for Multi-Axis 3D Printing (Alessandro Zomparelli, AiBuild)
description: AiBuild on a generalized framework for slicing geodesic toolpaths for multi-axis robotic 3D printing. CDFAM Amsterdam 2025.

name: Project Bernini: Generative AI 3D Shape Creation (Autodesk, AU 2024)
description: AU 2024 reveal of Project Bernini, Autodesk's experimental generative-AI model that produces 3D shapes from text, sketches, voxels, point clouds, or combinations. Positioned as the conceptual-design front end for Fusion / Forma.

name: Design Smarter, Not Harder: AI-Driven Comparison and Optimization with LLMs and Forma (AU 2024)
description: AU 2024 class showing how to use large language models with Autodesk Forma to compare and evaluate building-design options. One of the first vendor-led classes on LLM-in-the-loop AEC design.

name: Autodesk Neural CAD foundation models (AU 2025 announcement)
description: AU 2025 announcement of Autodesk's 'Neural CAD' foundation models — generative AI trained to reason about CAD objects and architectural systems, targeted at automating up to 80-90% of routine design tasks within Fusion and Forma.

name: Autodesk Assistant: Agentic AI Partner (AU 2025)
description: AU 2025 launch of Autodesk Assistant — an agentic AI embedded across Fusion and Vault that automates sketch constraints, manufacturing toolpaths, and team collaboration tasks. Frames the shift from feature-AI to agent-AI inside CAD.

name: Assembly Design with Agent AI (AU 2025)
description: AU 2025 research talk introducing agent-AI methods that collaboratively generate assembly geometry, model dynamic systems, and adapt designs from performance feedback. Early-stage prototypes for next-gen assembly authoring.

name: Fusion MCP Servers (Autodesk, AU 2025)
description: AU 2025 announcement of Model Context Protocol servers for Fusion, exposing Fusion data and operations to external AI agents. Significant for agent-CAD because it standardizes the integration surface.

name: BrepGen: B-rep Generative Diffusion Model with Structured Latent Geometry
description: SIGGRAPH 2024 paper introducing diffusion-based generation of B-rep CAD models with structured latent geometry. Bridges the gap between mesh diffusion and parametric-CAD generation.

name: Split-and-Fit: Learning B-Reps via Structure-Aware Voronoi Partitioning
description: SIGGRAPH 2024 paper that reconstructs B-rep CAD by partitioning point clouds with structure-aware Voronoi cells, then fitting parametric surfaces. Decouples topology and geometry inference.

name: NeurCADRecon: Self-Supervised Neural CAD Surface Reconstruction
description: SIGGRAPH 2024 paper on self-supervised neural SDFs with a developability-encouraging Gaussian-curvature loss. Lets neural SDFs reconstruct sharp feature lines suitable for parametric CAD recovery.

name: Neural Geometry Fields for Meshes
description: SIGGRAPH 2024 paper presenting a neural representation of triangle-mesh geometry built on coarse quadrangular patches with neural-field detail displacements. Strong mesh compression with high surface fidelity.

name: BrepGPT: Autoregressive B-rep Generation with Voronoi Half-Patch
description: SIGGRAPH 2025 paper using an autoregressive transformer over Voronoi half-patches to generate B-rep models. Pushes neural-CAD into GPT-style sequence modeling over geometric primitives.

name: AutoBrep: Autoregressive B-Rep Generation with Unified Topology and Geometry
description: SIGGRAPH 2025 paper that jointly autoregressively models B-rep topology and geometry rather than treating them as separate stages. Addresses validity issues in earlier two-stage approaches.

name: BrepDiff: Single-Stage B-rep Diffusion Model
description: SIGGRAPH 2025 paper extending BrepGen with a single-stage diffusion process directly over B-rep representations. Simpler training and competitive sample quality.

name: HoLa: Holistic Latent Representation for B-Rep Generation
description: SIGGRAPH 2025 paper proposing a unified latent representation for B-rep CAD that lets a single decoder generate full models without per-element decoding stages.

name: Stitch-A-Shape: Bottom-up Learning for B-Rep Generation
description: SIGGRAPH 2025 paper that constructs B-reps incrementally via learned stitching of patches. Bottom-up assembly yields high topological validity.

name: CLR-Wire: Continuous Latent Representations for 3D Curve Wireframe Generation
description: SIGGRAPH 2025 paper on a continuous latent space for 3D curve wireframes. Useful as a CAD-precursor representation between sketches and full B-rep models.

name: OctGPT: Octree-based Multiscale Autoregressive Models for 3D Shape Generation
description: SIGGRAPH 2025 paper using octree-structured autoregressive transformers for multiscale 3D shape generation. GPT-style scaling laws applied to geometry.

name: Unsupervised Decomposition of 3D Shapes into Editable Extruded Profiles
description: SIGGRAPH 2025 paper that unsupervised-decomposes 3D shapes into editable extruded-profile primitives — i.e. recovers a sketch-extrude CAD program directly from geometry.

name: PrimitiveAnything: Auto-Regressive 3D Primitive Assembly Generation
description: SIGGRAPH 2025 paper on auto-regressive transformer generation of human-crafted 3D primitive assemblies. Targets the cluttered-with-primitives style of organic CAD modeling.

name: DTGBrepGen: Decoupling Topology and Geometry in B-Rep Generation
description: CVPR 2025 paper that decouples B-rep topology and geometry into separate generative stages. Improves topological validity over earlier joint approaches.

name: CADCrafter: Generating CAD Models from Unconstrained Images
description: CVPR 2025 paper that produces CAD models directly from in-the-wild photographs — no calibration, no clean backgrounds. Significant step for image-to-CAD usability.

name: CADDreamer: CAD Object Generation from Single-View Images
description: CVPR 2025 paper synthesizing parametric CAD objects from a single image. Combines view-conditional diffusion with parametric program decoding.

name: Draw Step by Step: CAD Construction Sequences from Point Clouds via Multimodal Diffusion
description: CVPR 2024 paper that recovers procedural CAD construction sequences (sketches, extrudes, etc.) from point clouds via multimodal diffusion. Aligns with the DeepCAD program-recovery agenda.

name: CAD-SIGNet: CAD Language Inference from Point Clouds with Layer-wise Sketch-Instance Attention
description: CVPR 2024 paper inferring CAD programs (sketch-instance level) from point clouds using layer-wise instance-guided attention. Higher fidelity than prior end-to-end decoders.

name: Point2CAD: Reverse Engineering CAD from 3D Point Clouds
description: CVPR 2024 paper that reconstructs parametric CAD from unstructured point clouds. Strong baseline for the scan-to-CAD problem.

name: D2CSG: Unsupervised Compact CSG Trees with Dual Complements and Dropouts
description: NeurIPS 2024 paper that unsupervised-learns compact CSG (Constructive Solid Geometry) trees with dual complements and primitive dropouts. Cleaner CSG programs than prior CSG-Net approaches.

name: Slice-100K: Multimodal Dataset for Extrusion-based 3D Printing
description: NeurIPS 2024 dataset paper providing 100K parts annotated with slicing, toolpaths, and metadata for FFF/FDM. Enables learning-based slicing and printability prediction.

name: Geometry-Informed Neural Networks (GINNs)
description: ICML 2025 paper introducing data-free training of shape-generative neural fields driven by user-specified objectives and constraints. Avoids mode collapse; produces diverse geometry/topology variants for engineering design.

name: CADFusion: Text-to-CAD via Visual Feedback in LLMs
description: ICML 2025 text-to-CAD paper that fine-tunes an LLM by alternating sequential learning on CAD code with visual feedback from rendered designs. Cleaner natural-design output than prior text-to-CAD baselines.

name: FlexCAD: Unified Controllable CAD Generation with Fine-tuned LLMs
description: ICLR 2025 paper introducing FlexCAD, a fine-tuned LLM that supports unified controllable CAD generation under multiple condition types (text, sketches, partial CAD).

name: Generating CAD Code with Vision-Language Models for 3D Designs
description: ICLR 2025 paper using vision-language models to generate executable CAD code (CadQuery / OpenSCAD style) from images and prompts. Bridges VLMs and parametric-CAD scripting languages.

name: Don't Mesh with Me: Generating CSG Instead of Meshes by Fine-Tuning Code LLMs
description: ICLR 2025 paper arguing CSG code (e.g., OpenSCAD) is a better generation target than meshes for code-LLMs. Fine-tunes a code-generation model on CSG programs and shows quality wins.

name: AI Agents in Engineering Design: Multi-Agent Framework for Aesthetic and Aerodynamic Car Design
description: ASME IDETC-CIE 2025 paper proposing a multi-agent framework where specialized AI agents collaborate on aesthetic and aerodynamic automotive design. Demonstrates measurable quality and efficiency gains in concept-design loops.

name: GenCAD-3D: CAD Program Generation via Multimodal Latent Space Alignment
description: ASME IDETC-CIE 2025 paper introducing GenCAD-3D, which generates CAD programs by aligning text, sketch, and 3D modalities in a shared latent space and re-balancing synthetic training data.

name: CAD-Coder: Open-Source Vision-Language Model for CAD Code Generation
description: ASME IDETC-CIE 2025 paper releasing CAD-Coder, an open-source VLM specialized for CAD-code generation tasks (CadQuery / OpenSCAD). Provides reproducible baseline for the community.

name: Domain-Adaptive, Resolution-Free 3D Topology Optimization with Neural Implicit Fields
description: ASME IDETC-CIE 2024 (DAC) paper using neural implicit fields to perform 3D topology optimization that's resolution-independent and transfers across domain shapes — a major limitation of grid-based learned TO.

name: Generative GNN Framework for Connectivity-Guaranteed Porous Metamaterial Units
description: ASME IDETC-CIE 2024 paper using a generative graph neural network to design porous metamaterial unit cells with guaranteed connectivity. Solves a common failure mode in lattice / metamaterial generation.

name: Current State and Benchmarking of Generative AI for Additive Manufacturing
description: ASME IDETC-CIE 2024 paper benchmarking the state of generative AI tools across additive-manufacturing tasks. Provides a snapshot of where ML helps in AM and where it currently fails.

name: Human-AI Collaboration: Three Strategies of GenAI Use at NASA
description: ASME IDETC-CIE 2024 ethnographic study of an early-stage NASA design team using generative AI in speculative design. Identifies three usage patterns and how they shape outcomes.

name: Inside nTop's Bold New Design Frontier (Brad Rothenberg, Additive Snack)
description: Long-form podcast interview with nTop CEO Brad Rothenberg on implicit design, AI, and the next-gen design tools nTop is building. Best public source for nTop's strategic direction.

name: Generative Design Improves Arcimoto's FUV (Cool Parts Show S3E3)
description: Cool Parts Show episode on Arcimoto's Fun Utility Vehicle weight reduction using ParaMatters generative design plus AM. Concrete production case study, ~200lb mass-out target.

name: GM Seat Bracket with Autodesk Generative Design
description: Cool Parts Show / AM Magazine coverage of the GM-Autodesk seat-bracket — the canonical Fusion 360 generative design industrial case (40% lighter, 20% stronger, single 3D-printed part replacing 8). Often referenced in subsequent AI-CAD talks.

name: AI for Security and Defence Applications III (SPIE 2025)
description: SPIE Defense + Commercial Sensing 2025 conference series on generative AI for security/defense imaging. Includes diffusion-based data augmentation for vehicle detection and neuro-symbolic generative methods.

name: End-to-End Co-Optimization of Optical Sensors via ML (SPIE DCS 2024)
description: SPIE DCS 2024 sessions on end-to-end machine-learning co-optimization of optical sensor hardware with downstream exploitation. Includes ML-designed multispectral sensors optimized for scene segmentation.

name: Spherenes: Triply-Periodic Minimal-Surface Metamaterials (Christian Waldvogel, Spherene)
description: Spherene CDFAM Berlin 2024 talk on Spherene metamaterials — TPMS-based architected materials for simulation-based DfAM. Repeated at CDFAM NYC 2024 with simulation case studies.

name: Geometric Infrastructure for Additive Manufacturing (Elissa Ross, Metafold)
description: Metafold CDFAM Berlin 2024 talk pitching Metafold as the cloud geometry layer for AM workflows. Streaming-geometry compute for very large lattice / implicit designs.

name: From Lamps to Lungs (Nervous System, CDFAM 2024)
description: Nervous System (Jessica Rosenkrantz, Jesse Louis-Rosenberg) CDFAM NYC 2024 keynote tracing their work from generative jewelry/lamps to engineered tissue scaffolds. Long-arc case study of computational-design practice.
